text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yo, yo! Trainer-san! Tracen Academy really 
is as massive as they say!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The grounds alone are huge, but they've 
even got an outdoor stage, a gym, a 
practice paddock, and soccer and tennis 
courts too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Man, as expected of Tracen Academy, the 
finest Umamusume educational institution 
in Japan...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gonna watch ya real close! 
Reeeal close...! Dahahaha!
